# EvNavigationMenu

> The navigation menu is the top-level horizontal bar that anchors a desktop app — pairing the brand logo with primary navigation links and utilities (search, profile) so users can orient and move between sections.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| ID | `evoq-ui:navigation-menu` |
| Layer | Organism (`src/organisms`) |
| Import | `import { EvNavigationMenu } from 'evoq-ui'` |
| Template tag | `<EvNavigationMenu>` or `<ev-navigation-menu>` |
| Source | `src/organisms/navigation-menu/EvNavigationMenu.vue` |
| Extra attributes go to | the root `<nav class="ev-navigation-menu">` |

## Example

```vue
<EvNavigationMenu>
  <EvNavMenuItem active>Beranda</EvNavMenuItem>
  <EvNavMenuItem>Pengadaan</EvNavMenuItem>
  <EvNavMenuItem>Laporan</EvNavMenuItem>
</EvNavigationMenu>
```

_The exact snippet the playground simulator copies for this component (`playground/simulator-demos.ts`)._

Its default slot is built to hold `EvNavMenuItem` (`evoq-ui:nav-menu-item`).

## Design guidance

From the Figma page **Navigation Menu - Desktop**, frame `4347:81532` (Navigation Menu). These rules are binding. Names in them are Figma's - the Vue API is the tables above.

### When to use

- Use as the persistent top-level navigation for a desktop application — anchoring the brand, exposing primary sections, and housing global utilities like search and the user profile.

### When not to use

- Don't use for in-page section switching — use Tabs (`evoq-ui:tabs`).
- Don't use on mobile layouts — use the mobile navigation pattern (bottom bar or hamburger drawer (`evoq-ui:drawer`)) instead of this desktop bar.

### Do

- Keep navigation labels short and stable.
- Highlight the active section clearly.
- Use Tab Style when sections behave like switchable views, and Menu when they are distinct destinations.

### Don't

- Don't overcrowd the bar with too many top-level links — group secondary items into a menu or slot. Don't hide critical destinations behind search only.

## Contract

- Only the props, slots and events above exist on `EvNavigationMenu`; anything not listed is not part of its API.
- An attribute that is not a prop (`class`, `id`, `aria-*`, `data-*`) goes to the root `<nav class="ev-navigation-menu">`.
- Import it by name from `evoq-ui`; styles come once from `evoq-ui/style.css`.
- Refer to it by id `evoq-ui:navigation-menu` - the id stays the same if the component moves layer.
